visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens on an outdoor patio during daylight. A man in a beige t-shirt and brown cap stands centrally. A digital face filter of a celebrity is superimposed over his face. He gestures with his hands while looking into the camera. Behind him are a grill and a modern building. (2) The scene stays in the same location as the man speaks more dynamically. Large yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom. He maintains an upright posture and uses expansive hand movements to emphasize his speech. (3) A sudden cut shows two men in an outdoor grassy field with a large tree. One man sits while the other stands behind him, playfully touching his cheeks. Animated heart graphics and sparkling light effects are layered over the footage. (4) The scene returns to the patio where a second man, wearing a black t-shirt and black cap, enters the frame. They both face the camera, pointing at their apparel. (5) A brief insert shot shows multiple rows of brown caps neatly arranged on a wooden table surface indoors. (6) A promotional graphic appears on screen, displaying a navy t-shirt and two caps alongside text specifications. (7) The final phase returns to the patio where the first man no longer has the face filter. He looks at his friend and then back at the camera with a confused expression as they both laugh.
